// =============================================================================
// Integration Regression Test Template — React (Jest/Vitest + RTL + MSW)
// =============================================================================
// Use this template for integration-level regression tests that verify
// cross-cutting behavior across components, APIs, routing, and state.
//
// Three variants:
//   1. MSW Handler-Based API Integration
//   2. React Router (MemoryRouter) Integration
//   3. Full App/Page-Level Rendering with Providers
//
// Placeholders:
//   {{COMPONENT_NAME}}      — Target component name
//   {{PAGE_NAME}}           — Target page component name
//   {{SOURCE_FILE}}         — Path to the source file under test
//   {{API_ENDPOINT}}        — API endpoint path (e.g., /api/users)
//   {{STORE_REDUCER}}       — Redux reducer import path
//   {{CHANGE_DESCRIPTION}}  — Description of the change being tested
//   {{REQUIREMENT_ID}}      — Requirement/ticket ID
// =============================================================================

import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
// For Vitest, uncomment:
// import { describe, test, expect, vi, beforeAll, afterAll, afterEach, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

// ---- Variant 1: MSW Handler-Based API Integration ----

// @requirement {{REQUIREMENT_ID}}
describe('Integration Regression: {{COMPONENT_NAME}} API Integration', () => {
  const user = userEvent.setup();

  // ---- MSW Handlers (default success responses) ----
  const handlers = [
    http.get('{{API_ENDPOINT}}', () => {
      return HttpResponse.json([
        { id: 1, name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@test.com' },
        { id: 2, name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@test.com' },
      ]);
    }),

    http.post('{{API_ENDPOINT}}', async ({ request }) => {
      const body = await request.json();
      return HttpResponse.json({ id: 3, ...body }, { status: 201 });
    }),

    http.put('{{API_ENDPOINT}}/:id', async ({ request, params }) => {
      const body = await request.json();
      return HttpResponse.json({ id: params.id, ...body });
    }),

    http.delete('{{API_ENDPOINT}}/:id', ({ params }) => {
      return new HttpResponse(null, { status: 204 });
    }),
  ];

  const server = setupServer(...handlers);

  beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'warn' }));
  afterEach(() => server.resetHandlers());
  afterAll(() => server.close());

  // ---- Tests ----

  test('[{{REQUIREMENT_ID}}] still fetches and renders data from API', async () => {
    // render(<{{COMPONENT_NAME}} />);

    // await waitFor(() => {
    //   expect(screen.getByText('Alice')).toBeInTheDocument();
    //   expect(screen.getByText('Bob')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // });
  });

  test('[{{REQUIREMENT_ID}}] still handles API server error', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('{{API_ENDPOINT}}', () => {
        return new HttpResponse(null, { status: 500 });
      }),
    );

    // render(<{{COMPONENT_NAME}} />);

    // await waitFor(() => {
    //   expect(screen.getByText(/error/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // });
  });

  test('[{{REQUIREMENT_ID}}] still submits data to API on form submit', async () => {
    // let capturedBody: any;
    // server.use(
    //   http.post('{{API_ENDPOINT}}', async ({ request }) => {
    //     capturedBody = await request.json();
    //     return HttpResponse.json({ id: 3, ...capturedBody }, { status: 201 });
    //   }),
    // );

    // render(<{{COMPONENT_NAME}} />);
    // await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/name/i), 'Charlie');
    // await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i }));

    // await waitFor(() => {
    //   expect(capturedBody).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Charlie' }));
    // });
  });
});
